definitions.bronze_cells: Rows in bronze_excel_cells; includes cells with value, formula, fill color, or merged-range lineage.
definitions.silver_rab_candidate_rows: Parsed RAB-like rows before downstream mapping curation.
definitions.silver_rab_items_flexible: Current fact-ready Silver item rows after parser excludes headers, totals, and empty rows.
definitions.silver_nomenklatur_detail: Nomenklatur rows where one row equals one detail kegiatan with inherited hierarchy.
definitions.fact_anggaran_rows: Gold rows at item x IKU allocation grain. With one IKU or unmapped IKU this equals item rows; multi-IKU expands rows with allocation_weight.

quality_checks.rab_main_and_detail_duplication_policy: Parser excludes total/subtotal rows; duplicate check uses item_id + IKU/source lineage. Sheet-level source lineage remains available for audit.
